children: Counterpoint Research said global DRAM market revenue rose 385% year on year and 57% quarter on quarter in the second quarter of 2026, according to Jiemian News. Samsung Electronics held a 38% share of the market, SK Hynix 25% and Micron 24%, while CXMT's revenue share climbed to 10%, up 4 percentage points from a year earlier and 2 points from the previous quarter, ranking fourth.

title: Counterpoint: Global DRAM Market Revenue Jumps 385% in Q2 2026; CXMT Share Rises to 10%
